name: HD Fighters
description: HD Fighters 1.0: 218 fixed-roster texture entries covering main outfits, in-engine Story states, injury maps and five shared inputs. Includes 200 Rich Original Detail restorations with source-palette matching and preserved material alpha, plus explicit original/Lanczos fallbacks. Created-player customization, menus and prerecorded video are separate. Faithful HD is optional.
